english.title: Civil partnership registrar officiate at the signing of an unauthorised Registrar General's licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) officiated at the signing of a Registrar General's licence by proposed civil partners, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAMES..) in your

(A)_[capacity as a civil partnership registrar,]_
(B)_[purported capacity as a civil partnership registrar,]_

knowing that you did so

(C)_[at a place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..) not being the place specified in the licence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE IN THE LICENCE)]_
(D)_[in the absence of a civil partnership registrar]_
(E)_[after the end of 1 month from the day on which the notice of proposed civil partnership was given]_
(F)_[even though the civil partnership was void under section 49(b) of the Civil Partnership Act 2004]_
(G)_[even though the civil partnership was void under section 49(c) of the Civil Partnership Act 2004]_
(H)_[**(..SPECIFY A COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 32(2) and (3) of the Civil Partnership Act 2004.
